using namespace std;
int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }
    sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
    if (n == 1) {
        cout << arr[0] << endl;
    } else {
        if (n % 2 == 0) {
            cout << arr[n % 2 - 1] << endl;
        } else if (n == 5) {
            cout << arr[(n % 2) + 1] << endl;
        } else {
            cout << arr[n % 2] << endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
